environment.locale: C for sorted inventories; inherited locale for read-only grep counts
environment.privacy: internal minimized evidence; raw worktree paths, claim bodies, and mailbox bodies not retained

measures.name: retained discovery-read proxy
measures.command: git grep -i -E '(git worktree list|git status|rev-parse|show-ref|check_integration_hygiene)' ff7f7e8bad6de50d157c48b6fbeca29269ea8309 -- ':(glob)TODO-*.md' | wc -l
measures.limitation: Lower-bound documentary proxy; it does not observe unrecorded reads and must not be interpreted as user effort.

measures.name: explicit retained stale-handoff proxy
measures.limitation: Zero means no explicit retained phrase match, not proof that stale handoffs did not occur.

measures.name: integration-related corrective commits
measures.denominator: commits reachable from feature_ref since the fixed timestamp
measures.limitation: Subject-line proxy; exposure window and reachable commit population must accompany comparisons.

measures.name: explicit retained blocked preflight/hygiene proxy
measures.limitation: Documentary proxy; multiple lines may describe one event and unrecorded events are invisible.

measures.name: representative incident-to-terminal-recovery elapsed time
measures.limitation: Single representative episode measured by commit timestamps; trial comparisons must use the same named start/end event semantics and report sample count.

comparison_rule: A post value is comparable only when command semantics, population boundary, denominator, time/exposure window, exclusions, and limitations are retained. Otherwise report non-comparable and explain the drift; never normalize silently.
retention: Commit this minimized baseline and additive supersessions. Do not promote the raw temporary inventory extracts.
